from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug77418.phpt","function":"<global>","line":10,"var":"mb_regex_encoding","code":"mb_regex_encoding(\"UTF-32\");","note":"The mbstring regex engine can be switched to UTF-32, which changes how regex patterns are decoded before compilation."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug77418.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_split(\"\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x5c\\x00\\x00\\x00B\", \"000000000000000000000000000000\");","note":"A crafted UTF-32 regex pattern is supplied through mb_split, exercising the regex compiler on attacker-controlled bytes."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_split)","line":1240,"var":"pattern","code":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_split)","note":"mb_split is implemented in the mbregex layer and forwards the supplied pattern into the shared regex compilation path."},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1264,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if ((MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax)) == NULL) {","note":"The same compilation helper is used for mbregex APIs, so the crafted pattern reaches Oniguruma's parser and optimizer."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5441,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"During compilation, quantifier tuning recursively inspects the quantified body to classify empty-repeat behavior and memory-node interactions."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the suspected root cause path from the crash report, with the reported state names matching this analysis phase."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4904,"var":"NODE_CAR(node)","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(NODE_CAR(node));","note":"Nested list/alt nodes are traversed recursively, so a crafted pattern can force repeated visits through the same logical subtree."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5629,"var":"r","code":"r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The compiler propagates the analysis result into memory/backtrack bookkeeping, setting up the later invalid access."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_split)","line":1240,"var":"return_value","code":"mb_split returns the split result after regex compilation and execution","note":"If the crafted pattern triggers the vulnerable compiler state, the crash occurs while processing the regex rather than in PHP-level argument parsing."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
